restatement: Give Draft Day a gardener that groups repeated judge and verifier findings into lessons and proposes one engine check per lesson.

acceptance.when: gardener runs on the sample week
acceptance.shall: return exactly the seven lessons in the expected table
print the 36 lines of the text report
render it as text with no markup and only War Room pick links

rubric.name: Gardener fidelity
rubric.howToGrade: Run L1-L5 against fixtures/lessons/lessons-week.jsonl. 4 = exact lesson table. 2 = one wrong proposal. Evidence: test/lessons.test.ts:L1.

rubric.name: CLI and API parity
rubric.howToGrade: dd lessons and GET /api/lessons return the same JSON. Bad --since exits 2. Score 0-4 with evidence from test/lessons.test.ts:L11-L12.

rubric.name: Untrusted text safety
rubric.howToGrade: Hostile topics stay text. Every href matches ^#/picks/p-\d{8}-\d{2}$. Grep for innerHTML. Any markup = 0. Evidence: test/lessons.test.ts:L14. Score 0-4.

rubric.name: Clean stack, small diff
rubric.howToGrade: Touch map only. guards.test.ts byte-identical. Zero runtime deps. Score 0-4 from git diff --name-only START...HEAD.

designSketch: Boyd opens the Locker Room, sees seven lessons from five picks, taps a receipt into a pick page.
safetyFact: No lesson topic or receipt can render as markup or become a link outside this War Room's pick pages.
angles: Kind registry: one Record<FindingKind, KindRule> with satisfies so a new kind fails tsc until its row is complete.
Flat findings first: extract every finding into one list, then group and rank; Locker Room is a thin renderer of the API lists.
Weekly to-do: present lessons as Boyd's weekly checklist with the highest correction level first and a copyable check string.
